name: Thread ID in subject associates email with existing Case
description: Verifies that when an email subject contains a valid Case_Thread_ID referencing a pre-existing Case, the email is threaded to that Case and no new Case is created

emailProperties.subject: Re: Test-24-{{timestamp}} ref:_{{thread_id}}:ref
emailProperties.textBody: This is a reply that should thread to the existing case via subject thread ID.
emailProperties.htmlBody: This is a reply that should thread to the existing case via subject thread ID.
